comments.text: Which part of life in Afghanistan is hardest to understand from the outside - ancient traditions, marriage customs, or the hidden lives of women? #RealLifeInAfghanistan #AfghanistanTravel

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: A country that will risk their lives to protect and open their doors to a complete stranger (Pashtunwali), yet slams the school gates shut on hundreds of thousands of their own girls. This paradox is truly heartbreaking! Do you think absolute hospitality can ever compensate for the deprivation of basic human rights? 🇦🇫💔
